title: Determinant-preserving state invariant
statement: Let $p$ be a natural number and let $D_0$ be an element of the ring of integers modulo $p$. A state consisting of a list $R$ of rows of natural numbers and natural numbers $d,m,rc$ satisfies the invariant if $R$ has length $m$, each row has length $m$, every entry is less than $p$, $d<p$, and $rc\le m$. In addition, every row with index $i$ satisfying $m-rc\le i<m$ has first entry zero (using zero when the row is empty), and the determinant modulo $p$ of the $m$ by $m$ matrix formed from $R$, using zero for missing rows or entries, multiplied by $d$ equals $D_0$.
hypotheses_covered: Parameter $D_0$ is an element of the ring of integers modulo $p$
